categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of modern traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). The company focuses on three main product lines: respiratory system (led by patented Phlegm-Heat Clearing Injection and capsules), cardiovascular system (represented by Qishen capsules), and digestive system (represented by Sulfur Pronine series). It also operates subsidiaries specializing in pharmaceutical sales, equity investment, and health technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including fingerprint spectrum detection for quality control of TCM injections, GMP-certified production processes, and intelligent manufacturing systems integrating digital extraction, online quality monitoring, and full-process traceability. It emphasizes innovation in TCM modernization, including patented injection formulations and ongoing clinical research for product optimization and new indications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shanghai Kaibao serves hospitals, medical institutions, and pharmaceutical distributors across China, with products included in the National Basic Medical Insurance Drug Catalog. Its key markets are respiratory, cardiovascular, and digestive disease treatment sectors, with products used in clinical guidelines for infectious diseases and chronic conditions. The company’s sales network covers all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales regions divided into North, East, South, and West zones, covering all provinces and major cities. It has production and R&D facilities in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Henan and Anhui provinces. There is no significant international market presence reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Kaibao operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug formulation, manufacturing, and distribution. It independently manages procurement of raw materials, production, and sales, maintaining a complete and independent supply chain from raw material sourcing to end-customer delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in modern TCM, focusing on the secondary development of core products like Phlegm-Heat Clearing Injection, expansion of clinical indications, and development of new drugs including classic prescriptions and chemical drugs for respiratory and cardiovascular diseases. It invests in R&D platforms, collaborates with academic institutions, and enhances its talent pool to accelerate product pipeline development and market entry.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including injections, capsules, and tablets. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by regional distributors and third-party academic promotion services. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Kaibao is positioned as a leading modern TCM pharmaceutical company with strong proprietary products and patents, especially in respiratory disease treatment. It holds a competitive edge through patented products included in national clinical guidelines and strategic government support. The report does not specify direct competitors but highlights its status as a national high-tech enterprise and a top 100 Chinese TCM company.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.47 billion, a 7.57% decrease from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 14.55% to RMB 375.58 million. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 4.52 billion and equity of RMB 4.10 billion, with steady growth in profitability despite revenue fluctuations. R&D investment increased to nearly RMB 100 million, representing 6.77% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Kaibao emphasizes its unique patented TCM injection products with proven clinical efficacy and safety, especially in epidemic prevention and treatment. Its advanced manufacturing technologies, comprehensive quality control systems, and strong academic marketing strategies differentiate it in the market. The company leverages scientific evidence and clinical guideline endorsements to build brand trust and sustain competitive advantage.
